description: This Java source file defines the AclEnforcer class, which implements access control list (ACL) enforcement logic. It provides methods to check permissions for resources based on authorization context and ACLs, as well as methods to build JSON views and retrieve subjects with specific permissions.

classes.name: AclEnforcer
classes.description: Implements permission enforcement logic based on an access control list; provides methods to verify permissions and build JSON views.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an AclEnforcer instance with a provided AccessControlList.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has all permissions unconditionally for the specified resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has at least some of the specified permissions for the resource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON object view of a resource if permissions are granted.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the IDs of subjects with the specified permissions on the resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns the subjects with the specified permissions on the resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns the IDs of subjects with partial permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns the subjects with partial permission on the resource.

methods.name: mapPermissions
methods.description: Maps policy permissions to ACL permissions based on permission name.
